thread:
ashley: Heads-up 1 PR #528 landed a draft of the backpressure handbook in /docs/guides/backpressure.md. Found a few snippets out-of-sync with SDK 0.9; need a quick scrub.
jia: Which snippets specifically? I can update and add a migration note.
ashley: At the top we have `client.requestOptions({max_concurrency: 16})` 1 renamed to `concurrency_limit` in 0.9. We also mention `429_retry` as an opt-in flag; runtime now auto-handles that via fallback policies.
sam: I'll open a micro-PR to change the samples and add a tiny table mapping old->new names.
mike: Also add a short blurb about batching tradeoffs: bigger batches cut cost but can drive p99 up under backpressure. Saw a customer hit that when they increased batch_window.
jia: Drafted a compact diff for the snippet:```diff
- client.config({max_concurrency: 16})
+ client.config({concurrency_limit: 16})
```
olivia: Can we also add an integration example in examples/ that runs the SDK snippet against a mock server? That'll catch future regressions automatically.
ashley: Yes. @doc-bot please append a docs-qa checklist to PR: 1) samples compile & lint, 2) links verified, 3) migration note, 4) example CI
doc-bot: checklist attached to PR #528 1 items: samples-compile, links-verified, migration-note, example-ci
sam: I'll take sample compile + CI wiring. jia, can you author the migration copy and a short runtime fallback paragraph?
jia: On it. I'll add a "If you see more 429s after upgrading" mini-section with three actions: tune `concurrency_limit`, enable prefix/KV cache, and add exponential backoff with jitter.
mike: Suggest adding a quick staging repro command for noisy 429s: `hey -n 1000 -c 50 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` and a note to run it from within the same region.
olivia: Docs reviewer idea: add a "What changed (SDK <0.9 -> 0.9+)" callout at the top so integrators see breaking renames instantly.
ashley: Good. Also add a compact compatibility matrix: "old param -> new param -> runtime effect" so handbook stays scannable.
sam: Timeline: aim to ship docs PR by EOD Thursday. I'll slot a 10-min review in Thurs docs sync and ping #docs morning-of. :calendar:
jia: I'll have the migration copy + 429 troubleshooting blob by Wed EOD so Sam can wire examples.
ashley: After merge let's backport the migration note to the older troubleshooting page (0.8-era) so customers on older SDKs find it.
doc-bot: Backport issue will be created post-merge. :white_check_mark:
